text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report requests that Toronto and East York Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 11 Earnbridge Street. The application indicates the reason for removal is due to a conflict with the proposed construction of a swimming pool. The subject tree is a honey locust tree (Gleditsia triacanthos), measuring 38 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
The Item was Withdrawn from the agenda.
